simp.text: 这位老木匠做床做了几十年。

trad.text: 這位老木匠做床做了幾十年。
trad.bpmf: 這位老木匠做床做了幾十年。

example.en: This old carpenter had been making beds for decades.
The higher he climbed, the taller the mountain grew.
The trees in the forest were tall and packed close together.

simp.text: 这一路上，都是鸟在帮我。

trad.text: 這一路上，都是鳥在幫我。
trad.bpmf: 這一󠇡路上，都是鳥在幫我。

example.en: All along this road, it was the birds who helped me.

simp.text: 只要一碰到木头，木头就好像活了过来。

trad.text: 只要一碰到木頭，木頭就好像活了過來。
trad.bpmf: 只要一󠇡碰到木頭，木頭就好像活了過來。

example.en: The moment his hands touched the wood, the wood seemed to come alive.
The stones under his feet grew sharper and sharper.
He shut his eyes tight.

simp.text: 像小剪刀一样的尾巴一摆一摆。

trad.text: 像小剪刀一樣的尾巴一擺一擺。
trad.bpmf: 像小剪刀一󠇡樣的尾巴一󠇢擺一󠇢擺。

example.en: A tail like a little pair of scissors flicked and flicked.

simp.text: 好像下一秒就要拍著翅膀飞出来。

trad.text: 好像下一秒就要拍著翅膀飛出來。
trad.bpmf: 好像下一󠇢秒就要拍著翅膀飛出來。

example.en: It looked ready to flap its wings and fly out the very next second.

simp.text: 小凤凰的羽毛，他更是一根一根慢慢地刻。

trad.text: 小鳳凰的羽毛，他更是一根一根慢慢地刻。
trad.bpmf: 小鳳凰的羽毛，他更是一󠇢根一󠇢根慢慢地󠇡刻。

example.en: The little phoenix's feathers he carved one by one, slowly.

simp.text: 他把工具绑在一起，扛在肩上。

trad.text: 他把工具綁在一起，扛在肩上。
trad.bpmf: 他把工具綁在一󠇢起，扛在肩上。

example.en: He tied his tools together and shouldered them.

simp.text: 马上拿起挂在腰边的斧头。

trad.text: 馬上拿起掛在腰邊的斧頭。
trad.bpmf: 馬上拿起掛在腰邊的斧頭。

example.en: He quickly took up the axe hanging at his waist.

simp.text: 老木匠卷起袖子，准备开始做床。

trad.text: 老木匠捲起袖子，準備開始做床。
trad.bpmf: 老木匠捲起袖子󠇡，準備開始做床。

example.en: The old carpenter rolled up his sleeves and got ready to build the bed.

simp.text: 一只大老虎突然从草丛里跳了出来。

trad.text: 一隻大老虎突然從草叢裡跳了出來。
trad.bpmf: 一󠇢隻大老虎突然從草叢裡跳了出來。

example.en: A big tiger suddenly sprang out of the tall grass.
The eagle got a terrible fright.

vocab.en: the Bed of a Hundred Birds: the treasure bed of this legend, carved with one hundred kinds of birds

simp.text: 这张床，就叫牠『百鸟床』吧！

trad.text: 這張床，就叫牠『百鳥床』吧！
trad.bpmf: 這張床，就叫牠『百鳥床』吧！

example.en: This bed, I will call it the Bed of a Hundred Birds!

vocab.en: the phoenix: the king of all birds in Chinese myth, a sign of good fortune

example.en: The little phoenix flew slowly down.

vocab.en: magpie: a bird that traditionally brings good news

simp.text: 一只喜鹊飞到他前面的树枝上。

trad.text: 一隻喜鵲飛到他前面的樹枝上。
trad.bpmf: 一󠇢隻喜鵲飛到他前面的樹枝上。

example.en: A magpie flew to a branch in front of him.

simp.text: 一群燕子从树顶后面飞了出来。

trad.text: 一群燕子從樹頂後面飛了出來。
trad.bpmf: 一󠇢群燕子󠇡從樹頂後面飛了出來。

example.en: A flock of swallows came flying out from behind the treetops.

simp.text: 一大群啄木鸟抢先飞了过来。

trad.text: 一大群啄木鳥搶先飛了過來。
trad.bpmf: 一󠇡大群啄木鳥搶先飛了過來。

example.en: A whole flock of woodpeckers got there first.

simp.text: 老木匠心里一直藏著一个愿望。

trad.text: 老木匠心裡一直藏著一個願望。
trad.bpmf: 老木匠心裡一󠇢直藏著一󠇡個󠇡願望。

example.en: The old carpenter had carried one wish in his heart all along.

simp.text: 他马上决定去找那棵宝树。

trad.text: 他馬上決定去找那棵寶樹。
trad.bpmf: 他馬上決定去找那棵寶樹。

example.en: He decided at once to go and find that treasure tree.
The old carpenter kept walking on.

simp.text: 看到妈妈睡得这么舒服。

trad.text: 看到媽媽睡得這麼舒服。
trad.bpmf: 看到媽媽睡得󠇡這麼舒服。

example.en: Seeing his mother sleeping so comfortably.

simp.text: 让妈妈睡得舒服又安稳。

trad.text: 讓媽媽睡得舒服又安穩。
trad.bpmf: 讓媽媽睡得󠇡舒服又安穩。

example.en: So that his mother could sleep comfortably and restfully.

simp.text: 一看就知道不是普通的树。

trad.text: 一看就知道不是普通的樹。
trad.bpmf: 一󠇡看就知道不󠇡是普通的樹。

example.en: One look told him this was no ordinary tree.

vocab.en: to be torn, to be stuck over a hard choice

example.en: But in his heart he was torn again.

vocab.en: to vanish without a trace, leaving neither shadow nor footprint

simp.text: 一下子就飞得无影无踪。

trad.text: 一下子就飛得無影無蹤。
trad.bpmf: 一󠇡下子󠇡就飛得󠇡無影無蹤。

example.en: In an instant it flew off and vanished without a trace.

vocab.en: to be dripping with sweat, head covered in it, from effort or worry

simp.text: 怎么赶也赶不走，急得满头大汗。

trad.text: 怎麼趕也趕不走，急得滿頭大汗。
trad.bpmf: 怎麼趕也趕不走，急得󠇡滿頭大汗。

example.en: No matter how he waved them away they would not go, and he was soon dripping with sweat.

vocab.en: aching all over, with a sore back and a stiff waist, after hard work

simp.text: 累得腰酸背痛的人，往床上一躺。

trad.text: 累得腰痠背痛的人，往床上一躺。
trad.bpmf: 累得󠇡腰痠背痛的人，往床上一󠇢躺。

example.en: People aching all over from work would lie down on the bed.
